hints.title: Ordered Cell Processing
hints.text: Because relative order within each row and column must be preserved, smaller original values must receive smaller replaced values.

hints.title: Coordinate Sort
hints.text: Sort all matrix coordinates (r, c) by original value grid[r][c] in ascending order.

hints.title: Row and Column Maxima Tracking
hints.text: Assign each cell 1 + max(row_max[r], col_max[c]), then update both row_max[r] and col_max[c] to this new value.

hints.title: Coordinate Sorting Greedy Assignment Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minScore(self, grid: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
        m, n = len(grid), len(grid[0])
        cells = []
        for r in range(m):
            for c in range(n):
                cells.append((grid[r][c], r, c))
        cells.sort()
        row_max = [0] * m
        col_max = [0] * n
        res = [[0] * n for _ in range(m)]
        for _, r, c in cells:
            v = max(row_max[r], col_max[c]) + 1
            res[r][c] = v
            row_max[r] = v
            col_max[c] = v
        return res
```

complexity.notes: Sorting all m * n cells followed by linear greedy assignment.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Topological sort with DAG longest path adds graph construction overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stores coordinate list and row/col maximum arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that sorting cells and updating row/column maxima assigns minimal valid numbers.
